question: Who was appointed as the brand ambassador of FMCG brand Priyagold in September 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kiara Adwani. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In **September 2021**,** FMCG company Priyagold **signed Bollywood actress **Kiara Advani** as its** brand ambassador** and a **celebrity advocat**e for a variety of their products.
 
• Kiara Advani also presently serves as the brand ambassador for **Colgate, Myntra, and Senco Gold and Diamond.**
 
• Actress Kiara Advani, from India, performs in **movies in Telugu and Hindi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Akshay Kumar:**

 
 
• Akshay Kumar is a **Bollywood actor and producer** who was born in India and became a naturalized **Canadian citizen.**
 
• He has received numerous honours, including **two Filmfare Awards **and the **National Film Award for Best Actor.**
 
 
 
• **Vinod Kannan:**
 
 
• Vinod Kannan is the **Chief Executive Officer** of **TATA SIA Airlines Ltd.**
 
 
 
• **Kareena Kapoor:**
 
 
• ​Kareena Kapoor Khan is an** Indian actress** who appears in Hindi films.
